findings.title: Validate every checkout step, not just the first
findings.text: The test validates only the first `actions/checkout` step, so a second checkout added later without `fetch-depth: 0` would silently pass even though it would make the base revision unavailable. Iterate over every checkout occurrence and apply the same assertions to each.

findings.title: Clean up the captured report temp file
findings.text: The captured report file is created per run but never removed, so on a self-hosted runner each invocation leaks a temp file (the install step already cleans up its staging directory). Add an `EXIT` trap right after `mktemp` to remove it; the trailing `exit "$code"` still fires the trap and preserves the step's status.
